material_asset.prompt: Create a production bitmap material texture, a flat seamless monochrome swatch of fine linen bookbinding cloth viewed perfectly front-on. It will be color-multiplied with a mineral green Android app background. The whole square is uniform near-white (#F8F8F8) with delicate visible cotton weave and a few natural microscopic thread variations; whites range only from #E8E8E8 to #FFFFFF. Elegant tightly woven book cloth, not coarse burlap. Even diffuse light, absolutely no directional shading, no folds, no seams, no vignette, no border, no gradient, no objects, no words or letters, no illustrations. The weave should be tangible when viewed close, calm and almost invisible behind UI text. Fill every edge with the same material. Large square repeatable texture.
